summary: Lane C fills the afg-tier hole 13-24 with 12 anchors in the WEBTOON's own chapter space (the catalog's space, batch 19's T25 finding). Season 2 is a continuous, gap-free adaptation of webtoon ch 46-110: rows 13-24 run 46 -> 104 with no anime-original material and no skipped source, so every target row takes an anchor and none is anchor_hostile. Two independent per-episode sources carry the mapping — sololeveling.fandom's episode-page `adaptedFrom` {{WB}} field and animefillerguide's per-episode chapter table — and they agree EXACTLY on ten of the twelve rows (13,14,15,16,17,20,21,22,23,24); they differ only on two START values (ep 18: 71 vs 72; ep 19: 76 vs 77), delivered at medium confidence with the alternative flagged. The fandom's arc pages give a third, structurally independent view (Red Gate 46-55 = eps 13-14; Demon Castle 56-61 = ep 15; Retesting Rank 61-64 = ep 16; Hunters Guild Gate 65-75 = eps 17-18; Return to Demon Castle 76-89 = eps 18-21; Jeju Island 90-107 = eps 21-25; Recruitment 108-110 = ep 25) plus a chapter->event index (<ref>Chapter N</ref> on each arc event) that matches the episode summaries beat for beat. FENCE CHECK: row 12 -> 45 [41] is CORRECT (fandom episode field, AFG, and the chapter pages 41-45 all read Episode 12). Row 25 -> 108 is WRONG and is repaired to 110: AFG's continua cell stops the anime at ch 108 p.19 (the funeral), but the finale's closing sequence — Go Gunhee's B-rank request, the gate turning Red, the full shadow army incl. Beru, 'on to the next hunt' — is chapter 110 verbatim, and the Monarchs/Il-Hwan tease is ch 109's second half; the honest post-series resume is 111.

CBR: 'Episode 25 skips the entirety of Solo Leveling manhwa Chapter 109'; GameRant recommends resuming at 107 for the cut material.

Lee Minsung's introduction is moved: the fandom character page pins his webtoon debut to Chapter 67 {{WB}} (inside ep 17's span) but his anime debut to Episode 18 {{AN}}, where he appears in the car outside the Hunters Association at the episode's close. Position-neutral — it does not move either anchor.

repairs.why: The stored 108 comes from AFG's continua prose, which ends the anime at 'Chapter 108 (p. 1-19)' — Min Byung-Gyu's funeral. The episode runs two segments past that: ch 109's closing Monarchs scene (Rakan and Sillad in the ants' nest, Sung Il-Hwan watching) and the whole of ch 110 as the finale's last sequence (Go Gunhee's B-Rank gate request -> the gate turns Red -> the full shadow army incl. Beru -> 'on to the next hunt'), which is also the source of the episode's title 'On to the Next Target'. Three lines agree on 110: sololeveling.fandom's Episode 25 `adaptedFrom` = 'Chapter 104 - Chapter 110 {{WB}}'; the Recruitment Arc page = webtoon ch 108-110, anime Episode 25; GameRant's finale piece states Season 2 'concludes on Chapter 110'; ComicBook.com: 'Solo Leveling Season 2 adapts the manhwa till Chapter 110'. A4: END = the furthest mainline chapter adapted in running order.

structure.notes:
CHAPTER SPACE (confirmed, unchanged from batch 19). All numbers here are the WEBTOON's own serialisation numbering (KakaoPage/Piccoma ch N = Tappytoon/Tapas ch N), 1-200 with a separately-titled Prologue. The Yen Press PRINT edition re-chapters ('Chapters 18-21' = webtoon 98-110 in vol 7, 'Chapters 1-3' = webtoon 1-12 in vol 1) and must NEVER be joined against these anchors. Volume numbers are the D&C Media / Yen Press 15-volume split, verified mechanically from sololeveling.fandom Template:Volume & Chapter: v1 1-12 (+Prologue), v2 13-26, v3 27-44, v4 45-63, v5 64-81, v6 82-97, v7 98-110, v8 111-122, v9 123-134, v10 135-146, v11 147-158, v12 159-168, v13 169-179, v14 180-190, v15 191-200. Cross-checked against the per-chapter infobox `volume=` field (ch 45-63 = 4, ch 64-81 = 5, ch 82-97 = 6, ch 98+ = 7) — two views, no disagreement, and our single stored boundary v7 = 98-110 sits inside it.

FENCE ROW 12 IS CORRECT. Stored ep 12 -> 45 [41] {41-45} is confirmed three ways: fandom Episode 12 `adaptedFrom` = 'Chapter 41 - Chapter 45 {{WB}}'; AFG '41, 42, 43, 44, 45'; chapter pages 41, 42, 43, 44, 45 each carry `anime episode = Episode 12` (and ch 46 carries Episode 13). No repair.

FENCE ROW 25 IS WRONG BY TWO SEGMENTS — repaired 108 -> 110 (see repairs). The 108 is an artefact of AFG's continua prose, not of the episode.

SOURCE INDEPENDENCE. Two per-episode sources: (1) sololeveling.fandom episode pages `adaptedFrom` with the labelled {{WB}} webtoon space, (2) animefillerguide.com/anime/solo-leveling/ 's per-episode chapter enumeration. They are NOT copies of each other — they disagree on ep 18's and ep 19's START and on the finale's END. Both mark chapter straddles deliberately: AFG shares a chapter across rows at 4, 21, 27, 34, 37, 41, 51, 61, 96, 104; fandom shares at those plus 71 and 76. Third, structurally independent views on the same wiki: the ARC pages (arc -> webtoon range AND arc -> episode range) and the arc pages' chapter->event index (<ref>Chapter N</ref> per event), which I aligned beat-for-beat with the episode summaries for eps 19-24; GameRant's arc list reproduces the same arc ranges (46-55 / 56-61 / 61-64 / 65-75 / 76-89) from an independent outlet.

SOURCES THAT LOOK USEFUL AND ARE NOT. (a) solo-leveling.fandom.com is a MIRROR of sololeveling.fandom.com — identical `adaptedFrom` strings and an identical chapter-page set (the same gaps at 66-74, 76-80, 83-96, 99-104) — never count it as a second source. (b) The fandom chapter pages' `anime episode =` reverse index is only trustworthy where the pages are non-stub: it is exact for ch 40-63 but wrong for ch 65 (says Episode 17; the mining-team material is in ep 16 per both per-episode sources) and for ch 81 (says Episode 18; both sources put 81 in ep 19), and ch 82/97/98's body text all read 'is the 81st chapter' — copy-paste stubs. (c) CBR's 'Complete Guide to Which Chapters the Anime Adapts' drifts +1 on every arc boundary from Retesting Rank onward (it prints 62-65 / 66-76 / 77-90 / 91-108 / 109-110 against the wiki's and GameRant's 61-64 / 65-75 / 76-89 / 90-107 / 108-110) and puts ch 108 in the Jeju arc although ch 108 IS the funeral where Jinwoo meets Selner — cross-check only. (d) ScreenRant's finale explainer says to 'pick the series up at chapter #110, just around when Mrs. Norma Selner arrives' — Selner arrives in ch 109 and 110 is adapted, so its number is off; do not use it.

THE RUN IS GAP-FREE. Rows 13-24 adapt ch 46 -> 104 with no chapter skipped, no anime-original episode and no recap row; every 'Anime & Manhwa Differences' tab on eps 13-25 is empty or near-empty. No type correction is warranted anywhere in 13-25 (T27/T28). AFL has no page for this series; AFG's table carries no type column, so nothing contests the stored `canon` on any row.

FLAG #1029 (count_mismatch, 'anchors stale (sparse source page)') is answered for the anchor half: 13 stored anchors + these 13 = every one of the 25 rows now carries a researched chapter. The MU half stands — MangaUpdates has no entry for the manhwa at all, so there is no anime-coverage string to pin against and G32/G36 have nothing to say here.
